C0401.title: Microsoft Discloses Tycoon2FA AiTM Phishing Kit Operating at Scale
C0401.summary: In March 2026, Microsoft disclosed how the Tycoon2FA adversary-in-the-middle phishing kit operated at scale. The phishing-as-a-service kit can proxy a fake login flow, induce victims to enter credentials and complete MFA, and steal session cookies to bypass MFA protections.

references.title: Inside Tycoon2FA: How a leading AiTM phishing kit operated at scale
